Q01.sql:
WITH closures AS (
  SELECT
    site_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(is_account_closure_call, conversation_id, NULL)) AS closure_calls
  FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_contact_center.fct_calls`
  GROUP BY site_id
),
cost_2025 AS (
  SELECT
    site_id,
    SUM(total_expense) AS total_expense_2025
  FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_contact_center.fct_cc_site_cost_monthly`
  WHERE month_start BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY site_id
)
SELECT
  s.site_id,
  s.site_name,
  COALESCE(c.closure_calls, 0) AS closure_calls,
  COALESCE(k.total_expense_2025, 0) AS total_expense_2025
FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_contact_center.dim_cc_site` AS s
LEFT JOIN closures AS c ON s.site_id = c.site_id
LEFT JOIN cost_2025 AS k ON s.site_id = k.site_id
ORDER BY closure_calls DESC

Q02.sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(score_date) AS score_date FROM `fennmoor-dw.ml_scores.churn_score_v3`), high_balance AS (SELECT customer_key, AVG(avg_balance_30d) AS avg_balance FROM `fennmoor-dw.ml_features.feat_customer_daily` WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM `fennmoor-dw.ml_features.feat_customer_daily`) GROUP BY customer_key HAVING AVG(avg_balance_30d) >= 100000) SELECT s.risk_band AS churn_risk_band, c.segment AS segment, CASE WHEN c.tenure_months < 12 THEN '0-1y' WHEN c.tenure_months < 60 THEN '1-5y' ELSE '5y+' END AS tenure_band, COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_key) AS customers, AVG(s.churn_probability) AS avg_churn_probability FROM `fennmoor-dw.ml_scores.churn_score_v3` s JOIN latest l ON s.score_date = l.score_date JOIN `fennmoor-dw.dw_core.dim_customer` c ON c.customer_key = s.customer_key JOIN high_balance h ON h.customer_key = s.customer_key GROUP BY churn_risk_band, segment, tenure_band ORDER BY churn_risk_band, segment, tenure_band

Q05.sql:
WITH eom AS (
 SELECT
 account_key,
 product_code,
 DATE_TRUNC(balance_date, MONTH) AS month_start,
 ARRAY_AGG(ledger_balance ORDER BY balance_date DESC LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS eom_balance
 FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_core.fct_daily_account_balances`
 GROUP BY account_key, product_code, month_start
)
SELECT
 eom.month_start,
 p.product_line,
 SUM(eom.eom_balance) AS month_end_balance
FROM eom
JOIN `fennmoor-dw.dw_core.dim_product` p
 ON eom.product_code = p.product_code
GROUP BY eom.month_start, p.product_line
ORDER BY eom.month_start, p.product_line

  SELECT
    c.agent_user_id,
    DATE_TRUNC(c.conversation_date, WEEK) AS week_start,

Le6d5789b.sql:
WITH closers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_key, close_date
  FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_core.fct_account_closures`
  WHERE is_voluntary
    AND close_date >= DATE '2026-02-05'
),
calls_before_close AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_key, c.site_id
  FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_contact_center.fct_calls` AS c
  JOIN closers AS cl
    ON c.customer_key = cl.customer_key
  WHERE c.conversation_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(cl.close_date, INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND cl.close_date
)
SELECT
  s.site_id,
  s.site_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cbc.customer_key) AS closing_customers_called
FROM calls_before_close AS cbc
LEFT JOIN `fennmoor-dw.dw_contact_center.dim_cc_site` AS s
  ON cbc.site_id = s.site_id
GROUP BY s.site_id, s.site_name
ORDER BY closing_customers_called DESC
